title: Step 2c: SVR Data Prep - Scaling X & Y Independently with StandardScaler

cues.en: -: All right, so first we don't have a training set or test set here, so I'm going to remove this line of code.
cues.zh: 首先，這裡沒有訓練集或測試集，所以刪除這行程式碼。

cues.en: I'm going to, you know, remove that as well, all the index selections and here as well.
cues.zh: 這些也刪除，包括所有索引選取的部分，這裡也是。

cues.en: And I'm just keeping X.
cues.zh: 只留下 X。

cues.en: And then let's see what we have to do.
cues.zh: 接著看看還需要做什麼。

cues.en: All right, so first that's already more clean.
cues.zh: 好，首先現在乾淨多了。

cues.en: Now with what we have here, you know these three lines of code, we are indeed applying feature scaling to the matrix of features X, which is one of the things we have to do indeed.
cues.zh: 目前這三行程式碼，確實會對特徵矩陣 X 套用特徵縮放，這是必須做的其中一件事。

cues.en: That's good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: However, as we've just explained we also have to scale the dependent variable vector, the salaries, and of course and that's the important thing you have to understand
cues.zh: 不過剛才解釋過，也需要縮放依變數向量，也就是薪資。當然，這裡有個重要概念，必須理解，

cues.en: and figure out.
cues.zh: 並想清楚。

cues.en: We are not gonna use the same standard scaler object on both the matrix of features X and the dependent variable vector Y.
cues.zh: 我們不會對特徵矩陣 X 與依變數向量 y，使用同一個 StandardScaler 物件。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: That's because you know when you fit your object as C on your data, while it is going to compute the mean and the standard deviation of that same variable
cues.zh: 因為對資料擬合 sc 物件時，會計算該變數的平均值與標準差。

cues.en: and therefore, since of course we don't have the same mean and same standard deviation for our levels here and our salaries, well obviously we have to create two standard scaler object
cues.zh: 而職位等級與薪資的平均值、標準差，當然都不同，所以必須建立兩個 StandardScaler 物件。

cues.en: one that will be fitted to X in order to compute the mean and standard deviation of the position levels, and one that will be fitted to Y to indeed compute the mean
cues.zh: 一個對 X 擬合，計算職位等級的平均值與標準差；另一個對 y 擬合，計算薪資的平均值

cues.en: and the standard deviation of the salaries.
cues.zh: 與標準差。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 明白嗎？

cues.en: So that was the only important thing to understand.
cues.zh: 這是唯一需要理解的重要概念。

cues.en: And therefore here I'm actually going to call this SC object SC X in order to say that it's the scaler of the matrix of features X and here SC X as well.
cues.zh: 因此這裡把 sc 物件改名為 sc_X，表示它是特徵矩陣 X 的縮放器，這裡也改成 sc_X。

cues.en: And now I'm going to create a new standard scaler object, the one that will be used on our dependent variable vector Y.
cues.zh: 現在再建立一個新的 StandardScaler 物件，用於依變數向量 y。

cues.en: And therefore here I'm replacing SC X by, we're gonna call it SC Y, so that it's perfectly clear that this is a scaler of X, and this is a scaler of Y.
cues.zh: 所以把這裡的 sc_X 換成 sc_y，讓它清楚表示，這個是 X 的縮放器，而這個是 y 的縮放器。

cues.en: And now we are going to copy this, paste that right below, and here we'll just have three little replacements to do,
cues.zh: 接著複製這段，貼在下方，這裡只需要做三個小修改。

cues.en: which are first replacing X here by Y, then SC X here by sc Y and X here by Y, so that now we are ready to scale
cues.zh: 首先把這裡的 X 換成 y，再把 sc_X 換成 sc_y，最後把這裡的 X 換成 y。現在已經準備好，同時縮放

cues.en: both our matrix of features X and our dependent variable vector y.
cues.zh: 特徵矩陣 X 與依變數向量 y。

cues.en: Let's check it out.
cues.zh: 來確認一下。

cues.en: Let's run the cell.
cues.zh: 執行儲存格。

cues.en: And now we're going to add two new code cells to print the new X and the new Y and see what they have become.
cues.zh: 現在新增兩個程式碼儲存格，印出新的 X 和 y，看看它們變成什麼樣子。

cues.en: All right, so two new code cells, and let's start here with a print of X.
cues.zh: 好，新增兩個程式碼儲存格，先在這裡印出 X。

cues.en: Good, and then a print of Y.
cues.zh: 很好，接著印出 y。

cues.en: And now let's run these two cells here, starting with print X.
cues.zh: 現在執行這兩個儲存格，先從 print(X) 開始。

cues.en: And indeed, well, we have some perfectly scaled values of the position levels going from minus 1.5, and that corresponds of course to position level number one,
cues.zh: 確實，職位等級已經縮放好了，數值從大約 -1.5，當然對應職位等級 1，

cues.en: and 1.56, which corresponds to position level number 10.
cues.zh: 到 1.56，對應職位等級 10。

cues.en: All right, and now let's print Y, and this will be interesting here.
cues.zh: 好，現在印出 y，這裡會很有意思。

cues.en: The values will go from minus 0.7, which corresponds of course to the salary of 45,000 per year and 2.64, which corresponds to the $1 million salary.
cues.zh: 數值從 -0.7，對應每年 4 萬 5 千的薪資，到 2.64，對應 100 萬美元的薪資。

cues.en: And as you can see here, this time the values are in the range from minus one, to plus three.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這次數值範圍落在 -1 到 +3 之間。

cues.en: That's why in the data progressing part, I told you that usually standardization transform your values between minus three and plus three.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼資料前處理部分提到，標準化後的數值通常落在 -3 到 +3 附近。
